VIDiff deploy now validates artifact metadata against trusted workflow_run lineage, resolves missing pull-request association from the commit-to-PR API, blocks Pages publication for fork PR artifacts (comment/status fall back to Actions artifact or run links), and requires trusted producer identity for publish events: push/workflow_dispatch producers need canonical same-repo head_repository and producer-head default-branch ancestry, with workflow_dispatch additionally requiring default-branch ancestry for the artifact-target SHA; otherwise publish fails closed to artifact/run links. ZIP extraction remains path-safe, rejecting absolute paths, parent traversal, and symlink entries before deploy/status/comment updates.
